summary_1line: Bhishma explains indirect acts counted as Brahmanicide and begins listing sacred rivers and pilgrimage sites whose baths grant purification and heavenly merit.

image_candidates.scene_text: A lone pilgrim fasts and bathes at the confluence of the Ganga and Yamuna while priests offer water to the ancestors at dawn.
Ascetics’ forest hermitage burns as flames spread through huts and trees, symbolizing a grave sin against holy men.
Waves of the Chandrabhaga river shimmer as a fasting devotee stands waist‑deep in the water during a seven‑day purification vow.
